grammarFocus: 第三人称单数；do / does 问答；like；can / cannot；and / but。
title: Li Ming's Family Dinner
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，然后回答问题。短文是模拟教学材料，不是真实事件。所有答案必须来自短文。
passage: Li Ming is a Chinese student. He likes noodles and eggs. He does not like fish. His sister, Li Hua, likes fish and rice. She does not like eggs. Their mother, Mrs. Li, likes vegetables and fruit. She does not like meat. Their father, Mr. Li, likes meat and rice. He does not like fruit. On Sunday, the family eats dinner together. Li Ming can cook noodles. Li Hua can cook fish. Mrs. Li can make fruit salad. Mr. Li cannot cook, but he can wash the dishes. They are happy.

questions.explanation: 短文说“He likes noodles and eggs.”，所以选“noodles and eggs”。
短文说“She does not like eggs.”，所以Li Hua不喜欢鸡蛋。
短文说“Their mother, Mrs. Li, likes vegetables and fruit.”，所以是Mrs. Li。
questions.evidence: Their mother, Mrs. Li, likes vegetables and fruit.

questions.explanation: 短文说“He does not like fruit.”，所以Mr. Li不喜欢水果。

questions.prompt: When does the family eat dinner together?
questions.explanation: 短文说“On Sunday, the family eats dinner together.”，所以是星期天。
questions.evidence: On Sunday, the family eats dinner together.

questions.explanation: 短文说“Li Ming can cook noodles.”，所以Li Ming会做面条。
短文说“Mrs. Li can make fruit salad.”，所以她会做水果沙拉。
questions.evidence: Mrs. Li can make fruit salad.

questions.explanation: 短文说“Mr. Li cannot cook, but he can wash the dishes.”，所以他会洗碗。
questions.evidence: Mr. Li cannot cook, but he can wash the dishes.

grammar.title: 第三人称单数；do/does问答；like；can/cannot；and/but
grammar.explanation: 在一般现在时中，当主语是第三人称单数（如he, she, it, 一个人名）时，动词要加-s或-es。例如：like变成likes，cook变成cooks。否定用does not + 动词原形。疑问用Does + 主语 + 动词原形？can表示能力，后面直接跟动词原形，否定是cannot。and连接两个相似或并列的内容，but表示转折。
grammar.example: Li Ming can cook noodles. Li Hua can cook fish. Mrs. Li can make fruit salad. Mr. Li cannot cook, but he can wash the dishes.

questions.explanation: 主语She是第三人称单数，动词like要加-s，变成likes。fish的复数形式通常还是fish，但这里用原形即可。
questions.evidence: His sister, Li Hua, likes fish and rice.

questions.explanation: 第三人称单数he的疑问句用Does开头，后面动词用原形like。
questions.evidence: Their father, Mr. Li, likes meat and rice.

questions.explanation: cannot后面接动词原形cook，不能加-s。cannot是一个词，不分开写。
questions.evidence: Mr. Li cannot cook, but he can wash the dishes.

options: She likes eggs and she does not like fish.
She likes eggs but she does not like fish.
She likes eggs or she does not like fish.
answers: She likes eggs but she does not like fish.
questions.explanation: 前后意思转折，用but连接。and表示并列，or表示选择。
